questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'He said that he [finish] the report by Friday.'
options: would finish
would have finished
had finished
was finishing

questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'The teacher said, 'Be quiet!''.
options: The teacher told them to be quiet.
The teacher said to them to be quiet.
The teacher said them to be quiet.
The teacher said for them to be quiet.
questions.answer: The teacher told them to be quiet.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the following direct speech? 'I am sure that he will come,' she said.
options: She said that she was sure that he would come.
She said that she is sure that he will come.
She said that she was sure that he will come.
She said that she is sure that he would come.
questions.answer: She said that she was sure that he would come.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the conditional: 'If I had known about the meeting, I ________ it.'
options: would attend
would have attended
had attended
would be attending

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: 'If only I ________ all that money!'
options: didn't spend
hadn't spent
don't spend
won't spend

questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'The boss said, 'Don't forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.'
options: The boss said to the employees not to forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.
The boss said that they shouldn't forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.
The boss said to the employees not to forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.
The boss said that they mustn't forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.
questions.answer: The boss said that they shouldn't forget to submit the documents by 5 PM.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the direct speech? 'We must protect the environment,' the expert said.
options: The expert said that we must protect the environment.
The expert said that we should protect the environment.
The expert said that we have to protect the environment.
The expert said that we need to protect the environment.
questions.answer: The expert said that we must protect the environment.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct conditional type: 'By the time you arrive, the train ________ if it's not cancelled.'
options: has left
had left
would have left
will have left

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: 'If I ________ you earlier, I could have helped you.'
options: knew
had known
would know
should know

questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'The children said, 'We are going to the zoo tomorrow.'
options: The children said that they were going to the zoo the next day.
The children said that they were going to the zoo tomorrow.
The children said that they are going to the zoo tomorrow.
The children said that they will go to the zoo tomorrow.
questions.answer: The children said that they were going to the zoo the next day.
